description: Enjoy hilltop living with gorgeous views in South San Francisco! Built in 1952, this 3-bedroom property features a newly installed roof (2025), new gutters, and double-pane windows. Parquet hardwood floors grace the living and dining areas. The main level offers white appliances, Formica countertops, and abundant storage. Outside, relax in a large yard, perfect for outdoor living. Includes a 1-car attached garage, a second bath with a walk-in shower, wall furnace heating, and crawlspace storage. Set in a welcoming neighborhood with low $6/year HOA fees!
